rs.innovation_approach: 把latent接口拆成slot内容、边界marker及格式，先构造有利于视觉记忆假说的MVH，再以分离干预、真实donor交换、样本级覆盖和受控注意力移植检验机制。
rs.key_step: 保持相同marker、位置、层或图像attention总质量，仅替换待测内容/分布；将整接口删除与保留损坏接口分开，用Normal独有解集而非总准确率定义marker覆盖。
rs.why_non_obvious: 高准确率、可视化结构和视觉空间对齐均可与内容不承重共存；删除整段同时破坏格式/计算/控制，不能独自识别内容贡献。
rs.trigger_condition: When an inserted representation improves accuracy but may confound content, protocol and compute, intervene on these factors separately and test portable content with matched donors and controls.
rs.acceptance_signal: low_evidence: manifest decision=null and no reviews_path; no review note source inspected.
rs.abstract_strategy: Decompose a bundled intervention and test each proposed causal role with matched controls under favorable conditions.
rs.abstract_key_step: Preserve the surrounding protocol while replacing content, then compare recovered individual successes and transport across contexts.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: Aggregate benefit can arise from a protocol or computational opportunity even when the presumed stored information is dispensable.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When performance is compatible with competing mechanisms, give the claimed mechanism favorable conditions and compare interventions that isolate its predicted effects.

signatures.object: 作为视觉记忆假说有利探针的MVH连续latent targets及两阶段训练
signatures.information: 训练时helper image（crop/annotated/simulated state）、冻结视觉编码器post-merger tokens及最后window attention、EMA teacher的前序文本hidden；训练答案/格式标签。推理仅原图+问题、无helper teacher。不是无标签工具价值测量。
signatures.operation: 构造global+3×3区域均值10个coverage targets；incoming-attention×query-softmax选top10 anchors，再用task-free对称encoder attention按.6 self+.4全图neighbor改写。norm对齐后注入20个槽，shifted cosine+text/marker CE训练；RL/eval用8槽，G8 outcome/format reward标准化，同一A分别进入text PPO及detached rollout latent cosine，并加冻结SFT anchor。
signatures.output: 高准确率、有输入/问题变化及双角色组织的模型，供因果诊断；不是已证实的视觉memory。
signatures.claimed_effect: 作者Table1 MVH-SFT/RL四benchmark均值67.8/69.7%，Monet-SFT/RL66.5/67.6%；exact-data Monet-RL67.5。FigA1 MVH-S跨样本cosine .68，BSR1.13，RSR1.12。TableA11同SFT起点RL 68.2→69.7。
conditions: 结构诊断独立于准确率，以免用准确率循环证明memory
原始RL数据pipeline匹配但并非exact matched，另有Monet retrain控制
核心机制诊断是Qwen2.5-VL7B六设置；Qwen3-VL8B仅CoMT扩展

evidence.quote:
Accuracy alone would be a circular justification for
the probe; the structural diagnostics above are independent of accuracy, and they show that MVH’s
slots respond to the input and to question variation
in ways the visual-memory account would predict.

signatures.failure_boundary: 有利probe并不穷尽所有memory设计；结构多样性与cosine接近不能证明内容因果。TableA10 rho=.6与.2均值67.8并列，不能声称唯一最佳。训练20而评测8的fixed-checkpoint sweep不能消除训练错配。

signatures.object: latent slot内容、marker身份、接口格式对准确率与独有解的贡献
signatures.information: 同一已训模型的实际输入embedding/decoded answers、每题正确性；看不到所有潜在内部计算，不是逐步人工观测必要性金标。
signatures.operation: 保留marker/布局时替换slot为zero、等scale Gaussian、按位置固定向量；比较K=0只留marker、NoLatent整段移除且禁marker、ZeroMarker留位置但置零。57题forced-prefix对照不同marker/等长度slots；计算Normal\NoLatent独有解被K0覆盖的MOC，并记录loop率。
signatures.output: slot/marker/format/malformed四类差分、每题MOC、marker身份及损坏生成敏感性。
signatures.claimed_effect: 作者TableA14 benchmark平均slot-sensitivity 0.3–2.7pp；marker敏感性MVH-S58.5、MVH-R37.8、ILVR-S165.1pp而其余≤1.9pp。TableA18 MOC均值依次.94/.97/1/.92/.78/.43；Monet-R例外。Fig4 marker置零MVH自循环100%，ILVR-S197%。
conditions: 不把ZeroMarker损坏执行等同NoLatent干净删除
MOC分母只用Normal正确且NoLatent错误的同题集合，报告小分母
forced-prefix与free generation分开报告，等长条件控制计算机会
核心six settings四MC benchmarks；额外3checkpoint只扩展部分测试

evidence.quote:
High MOC does not imply that latent slots are
functionally irrelevant; it shows that the examples
uniquely gained by the latent tokens are usually not
dependent on precise slot contents.

signatures.failure_boundary: MOC高不表示slots没有计算/时序价值；格式改变可制造OOD损坏，且原图一直可访问。少量分母（Monet-R V*/MME各2题）不可当稳定比例；slot-sens=均值差也不是所有单一扰动的最大差。

signatures.object: latent内容作为可恢复、可移植视觉记忆的预测
signatures.information: 同策略image-conditioned真实运行捕获的slot states、blank-image同prompt运行、同层donor和target状态、答案letter。状态是策略本身而非外部冻结reader，但移植可改变相容性。
signatures.operation: 捕获final-layer图像条件states，在blank图运行对应位置注入，按(Ainj-Ablind)/(Afull-Ablind)算gap recovery；为降低zero/random OOD争议，再固定prefix和位置，在L5/L14/L27注入真实donor，selfswap、同答案、异答案、random donor及same-image不同问题作控制；报告accuracy和donor adoption/bootstraps。
signatures.output: missing-image recovery、跨样本donor内容转移及hook自一致性读数。
signatures.claimed_effect: MVH-S full .845(n58)、blind .228(n57)、injected .276(n58)，recovery7.8%，CI[-15.2,28.6]百分点。TableA17 pooled adoption5.3–12.7%，全部CI低于四选一25%；same-image FigA4 MVH-S .28接近chance而非全低于chance。
conditions: 捕获与注入相同slot位置和decoder layer
self-swap验证hook近似保真，TableA16仍有两设置−.018
注入只在emit valid latent的子集，保留57/58筛选差异

evidence.quote:
Its wide
interval includes zero, so this result is directionally
consistent with the other tests but is not decisive
on its own.

signatures.failure_boundary: blind injection宽CI不能独立排除较大收益；真实donor来自分布内运行不保证donor-target联合干预分布内；仍可能依赖匹配问题、残余视觉访问、其它layer或读出。25%是作者四选一参照，异标签donor设计和label偏好须审计，不能当全机制零效应证明。

signatures.information: 同模型latent/answer逐层image attention、latent-gained V*样本、oracle target patches；后者仅实验控制，不是可部署信息。

signatures.output: attention分布干预的效应与特定位置超出集中度的增量；将相关性probe推进到受控干预。

No steering为0是选样构造，不是全benchmark精度0

This does not establish equivalence or rule out localization information at the available sample sizes.
Oracle attention also recovers only 49–60% of the
latent-gained sets, so attention is not an exhaustive
account of the gain.

signatures.failure_boundary: 未检出定位优于同熵random不等于两者等效或证明定位无用；oracle也只恢复49–60%，attention非完整解释。峰值选择和gain子集是诊断性选择，不能当总体泛化收益。

limitations.text: 全图在回答阶段可访问的latent-slot接口；强bottleneck/受限图像访问/外部视觉工作区不在结论范围。
limitations.quote:
Our analysis focuses on latent visual reasoning
methods that use a full-image VLM interface and
insert latent slots into the decoding sequence. Architectures that enforce a stronger visual bottleneck, restrict image access during answer generation, or use explicit external visual workspaces
may show different balances between slot contents, boundary markers, and format.

limitations.text: 不排除计算、时序、格式或路由用途，也未覆盖视频/embodied/long-horizon。
limitations.quote:
Finally, our diagnostics are
designed to test whether slot contents act as recoverable visual memory; they do not rule out other
roles for latent slots, such as providing computation, timing, formatting, or routing capacity during
decoding.

question.observed_failure: 作者在latent方法相近V*约.80–.83时发现slot扰动平均敏感性至多2.7pp，marker扰动可掉65.1pp；全接口提升不能唯一支持slot-memory解释。
question.load_bearing_assumption: 插入连续latent token带来的准确率提升主要来自其中可恢复的视觉信息内容。
question.scope: full-image Qwen-family latent interfaces，6 method-stage主要设置×4 perception-heavy MC benchmarks；部分延伸到9checkpoint、TextVQA/CoMT，不是全套跨所有模型。
question.success_criterion: 分别检验content causal sensitivity、blind recovery、donor portability及独有解覆盖；用干净删除、损坏接口、等长/同熵控制识别竞争机制。不是准确率提升/省crop的产品成功判据。
question.why_open: 既有CapImagine/latent critiques把latent span当整体，删除与dummy替换难以分开slot内容、marker和格式，且可能归因于低质/塌缩latent；MVH有利probe与分项干预针对这两点。

moves.quote:
Latent tokens (Figure 2B) have three components
that can be intervened on separately: the slot contents, the boundary markers, and the latent format
(its presence, position, and length). We exploit
this separability throughout the analysis. Each test
in Sections 4–5 changes one component at a time
and looks at how accuracy or generation behavior
responds.
moves.mapping_note: 实际先定义slot/marker/format再分离测量，后又将MOC定义为样本集合覆盖而非aggregate accuracy。对应计量口径澄清，不是论文出现step一词即匹配。

moves.quote:
The protocol keeps marker positions,
slot positions, and decoder layer identical across
donor and target, so any change observed after
the swap is attributable to the slot contents rather
than to the layout.
moves.mapping_note: 实际保持位置/层一致交换内容，并用selfswap确认hook；attention test另固定总mass与熵。

moves.quote:
before running causal interventions,
we verify that MVH latents are nontrivial enough
for the slot-content memory hypothesis to be worth
testing. They are not intended to prove content
causality.
moves.mapping_note: 先检查latent多样性/角色分离再做因果诊断；MVH本身已训练，因此只对应诊断先行的局部动作，不称全文先测量再训练。

moves.quote:
We therefore decompose latent tokens into three
independently testable components: latent slots,
boundary markers, and format, and intervene on
each in isolation.
moves.mapping_note: 拆解whole-interface ablation的混杂，以保持格式的content替换、marker identity及attention sharp-random等对照识别真实承重因素。

moves.quote:
The
coverage block Gt is question-independent and
preserves global scene structure (§A.3); the informative block It is question-dependent and
rewrites high-information-density anchor tokens
with question-relevant evidence
moves.mapping_note: MVH实际对question-independent coverage做区域平均，对question-dependent anchors做选择/关系重写。是不同资源角色不同操作，不是把诊断列表当异质分解。

objective.signal_routing: Stage1：文本与marker受CE监督，image/latent labels=ignore；latent i目标对应前一个位置z_{i-1}，首slot由lat_start状态预测，不能错成同位置自重建。Teacher helper图仅训练注入，EMA forward产目标。Stage2：同一轨迹标量A_g传到离散text token PPO及所有连续slots cosine；rollout z detached，SFT reference frozen。没有局部步骤独立reward/A，也没有连续slot概率密度/importance ratio。Eq25没有显式text reference-KL项；正文类比PPO reference-KL，不能自行补系数。诊断干预无需policy更新。
objective.normalization_notes: Eq21组均值/std+epsilon，epsilon值和sample/pop std未给；reward正确性.9/格式.1先混合后标准化。视觉selection先incoming attention L1归一再query softmax再乘积归一；rewriting selfmasked row softmax；target norm约为mean embedding norm。SFT文本式写sum、latent写mean，实际batch/token reduction未完全给。诊断accuracy多为四benchmark无权均值；TextVQA continuous score仅MOC二值化threshold .5。
objective.invariance: 作者无策略不变性定理。读者推导：对非零向量cosine对正比例scale不变；norm对齐约束注入input尺度，不保证student output norm。组reward共同正比例scale在epsilon忽略时消去，共同常数平移消去；.9/.1相对比例仍影响排序。RL latent anchor是soft方向正则，无硬信赖域半径或KL界证明；干预保持的是控制变量，不是政策最优性。
objective.baseline_or_potential: GRPO baseline是同prompt组均reward；SFT reference是方向anchor而非估算动作价值的critic/冻结reader。Teacher encoder frozen、EMA student提供query hidden；无MC fork价值差/势函数塑形。诊断以同模型NoLatent/K0/selfswap、同熵random为各自特定基线。
objective.degenerate_cases: 读者推导：组全同reward时A=0，text PPO和advantage cosine项为0，但anchor仍可能更新；全对/全错若format不同则A未必0。p(tool)≈0/1没有支撑保障，本方法未设计crop/direct均衡。K0是诊断条件，Llat若无slot不能直接按|S_lat|除0，训练fallback未报。MOC分母空未定义，极小分母不稳；full=blind时recovery未定义。若zθ与detached rollout z完全同向，cosine对zθ梯度为0（负A也一样）；首次on-policy精确回放可能满足，但实际teacher-force/数值/后续text更新会破坏相等，论文未给梯度诊断，不能据此断言训练无效。rho=1退化无neighbor rewrite；one-turn仍有latent/text losses但无跨轮memory保证。

evidence_design.discriminating_experiment: 组件干预+独有解覆盖辨别content与marker/format；真实same-layer donor/selfswap降低简单corruption争议；blank injection检查recoverability；固定image mass、匹配entropy的random attention对照辨别定位与集中度。四测试检验不同假设，一致负结果只约束所测portable memory解释。
controls: TableA1/1 SFT data/backbone/hparams matched；Monet原RL exact data未知，C3 exact-MVH-data VLPO重训67.5 vs67.6，仍混有SFT target/objective差异。
TableA12 K0、NoLatent与ZeroMarker不同：损坏marker仍能生成并loop，干净去掉协议应单列。
G4六设置×三层×四donor=72 subjobs，固定57题V* forced-prefix；same-image differentquestion进一步控制图像上下文。
H9种prefix、with/without length-matched slots，测marker身份和计算容量；未称forced slots为中性自然推理。
A19同样latent-gained题，No steering=0由选择决定；A20 paired bootstrap所有CI含0。
C1额外3checkpoint、C2仅MVH TextVQA没有FixedSlot；C4 fixed-checkpoint K4–20 plateau，不能当独立每K重训。

negative_results.text: probe多样性/视觉对齐并未转成slot-memory因果依赖。
negative_results.quote:
Together, slot contents show little perturbation sensitivity, do not substantially recover
missing visual input, show little donor-specific
transfer across examples, and are not needed for
most of the unique latent-token gain. These results
do not support the visual-memory account, even
when latent slots are trained with content-favorable
MVH supervision.

negative_results.text: 把任务偏好重新放进rewrite softmax让所有anchors塌缩到同高分token，作者改为task-free relation。
negative_results.quote:
The blend is taken over the whole image rather than
a local neighborhood, and wj,k is deliberately kept
task-free: injecting log pt or qt into the softmax
was found to collapse all Ki anchors toward the
same high-score tokens.

negative_results.text: 匹配同熵random后不能可靠归因于latent定位，且oracle也不能恢复全部增益。
negative_results.quote:
The paired analysis detects no reliable advantage
for the model’s own latent-time localization over

an equally concentrated random-location control.

negative_results.text: 训练20/评测8错配仍存在，即使K4–20结果平坦。
negative_results.quote:
The sweep does not retrain a separate
model at each slot count and therefore does not
remove the Stage-1 train/inference mismatch.

evidence_design.seeds_notes: App.B称原six-setting accuracy averaged over multiple independent runs，但未给次数、seed值或明确训练/解码随机源，故不填single也不编造3。扩展B1000 sample-level bootstrap不等于训练seed区间。
evidence_design.falsifier: 读者提出未执行：在selfswap无损、上下文/位置/计算预算匹配下，若真实target slots相对条件匹配donor/固定slots稳定提高，并在answer不可再次访问原图的受控bottleneck恢复视觉精度，则会限制本文negative generalization；若attention transplant−same-entropy random在预设足够功效样本上正下界>0，才支持具体定位。对本课题仅迁移控制原则，真实crop相对同尺寸同token-budget无新信息响应须有增量且通过selfsplice。

setup.model: main six settings Qwen2.5-VL-7B; CoMT additionally Qwen3-VL-8B

engineering.setup_notes: ILVR Stage1/2主表各3epoch；CoMT MVH-S/ILVR1各15epoch、MVH-R/ILVR2各2epoch。训练框架/LR/batch/总updates/GPU配置/采样温度未报。表A1的E2是每rollout PPO epoch，不能与完整RL2epoch混同。
engineering.cost: 未报告训练总token、优化step、wallclock或GPU·h。每SFT step额外EMA teacher forward，RL需detached rollout reinjection和frozen SFT reference forward；量化开销未给。G4明确72子任务×57题原V*网格。I中full-sequence HRBench8K attention replay因memory cost未做，不能把V*注意力结果说成四benchmark全面复现。

pitfalls.text: 输入向量同维度不等于同尺度，注入前按初始embedding平均L2 norm校准，避免单纯scale异常。
pitfalls.quote:
Teacher targets τt,i ∈ Tt live in the vision-encoder
post-merger space, which shares dimensionality
with the LLM input embedding space but not its
scale.

pitfalls.text: 结构目标前移一位对齐，latent/image labels忽略而marker保留CE。
pitfalls.quote:
with labels at latent and image positions set to the
ignore index; the boundary markers remain supervised so that the model learns when to open and
close the latent tokens.

pitfalls.text: 负advantage cosine方向无约束，作者用frozen SFT cosine anchor软约束。
pitfalls.quote:
Equation (23) alone is
direction-unconstrained for negative advantages.
We anchor the policy to the frozen Stage-1 checkpoint θSFT

pitfalls.text: blind实验有效样本过滤不完全相同；必须保留n58/n57差异而非假装全配对同样本。
pitfalls.quote:
with the image replaced by zeros, both with the
captured slot states injected at the corresponding
positions (n = 58) and without any injection (n =
57 after a prompt-formatting filter).

pitfalls.text: 受内存限制的attention replay不可声称全suite覆盖。
pitfalls.quote:
All
layer-wise attention analyses use the V∗ subset
used for attention replay; full-sequence HRBench8K replay was omitted due to memory cost (persetting values in Table A21).

engineering.lesson: 当结构化中间表征提升准确率时，先保留协议/长度与已有信息访问、只替换内容，再用selfswap确认干预管线；同时测损坏接口与干净删除，并以同熵random区分注意力集中与定位。高MOC/低可迁移性只能否定相应内容解释，不能省略slot计算容量和信息访问条件。

relevance.how: 直接提供对两分支测量竞争解释的诊断原则：格式/长度/内容分开且self-intervention作管线验证；未直接测crop必要性。
内容替换可因协议损坏/相容性改变而失真；NoLatent、ZeroMarker、selfswap不同基线提供可迁移对照。
attention差CI含0明确不当等效，blind injection不精确仅supporting，适合纠正本课题持平判断。
forced-prefix 57题结果与自然生成分开，相关于prefill改变策略行为的诊断风险。
sample bootstrap vs independent runs区分，但未给训练seed具体方差。

unknowns: 训练框架、硬件、wallclock、token/updates、LR/batch、rollout温度、maxturn、训练/解码独立run的次数seed及各run结果
std实现/epsilon，text reference-KL是否另有实现及系数，实际loss reduction，negative cosine首次回放gradient是否非零
blind 57/58过滤后paired bootstrap具体对齐，pooled donor总样本数/label匹配概率，same-image多问题原始对照记录
image attention entropy在image内renormalization及oracle region具体构造细节、峰层选择独立性
完整诊断源代码/原始逐题输出未核验；没有独立科学复现

source_ambiguities.issue: slot perturbation小影响的指标口径
source_ambiguities.detail: 主文称accuracy moves at most.027；A14给Normal−avg(Zero,Random,Fixed)最大2.7pp而单benchmark范围可达4.1pp。应限制为benchmark-averaged sensitivity，不能称每题/每扰动/每benchmark最大2.7。FigA2图例未显示FixedSlot，无法仅凭图重构三扰动平均。

source_ambiguities.issue: 结构probe不能偷换内容因果
source_ambiguities.detail: FigA1 baselines位置分半BSR1.12/1.11亦高于1；MVH RSR1.12/1.11 vs1/.98才是同图跨问题角色证据。FigA1 ILVR行未明确stage，而App.E将Stage1描述为多样，避免泛化所有ILVR都collapse。

source_ambiguities.issue: soft cosine anchor不是严格trust-region边界
source_ambiguities.detail: 作者称bounded direction-only neighborhood，但Eq24是soft penalty且无半径/步长界；Eq25不含显式text KL。record按soft正则保留原式，不补常见GRPO实现。

source_ambiguities.issue: global干预实现语句与特殊layer-swap协议
source_ambiguities.detail: App.F称all interventions input embedding level，App.G.4明确L5/14/27 hidden-state swap；按F的基础条件与G特殊干预分别记录，不把所有干预统一写成embedding操作。
blind baseline过滤1例，图像/注入n58；作者称paired uncertainty但未交代被过滤例如何配对。Monet-R MOC两benchmark分母各2；Monet-R attention表n2，不能作强generalization。
